identity.title: The ALMA Spectroscopic Survey in the Hubble Ultra Deep Field: Molecular Gas Reservoirs in High-redshift Galaxies

claims.hypothesis: Do IR-luminous UDF galaxies show CO emission as expected from L_IR-L'CO?
claims.experiment: CO fits at known positions of 11 galaxies with L_IR>1e11
claims.finding: Most lie on the low-L_IR envelope of the relation with exceptions

evidence.quote: Out these, 7 are detected at various significance in CO, and 4 are undetected in CO emission.

claims.hypothesis: Are dust-based gas masses consistent with CO-based masses?
claims.experiment: Compare three dust recipes with CO masses for six continuum-detected galaxies
claims.finding: Systematic offset not resolved by tuning CO assumptions

evidence.quote: On average, the dust–based estimates of the molecular gas are a factor $\sim$2–5$\times$ smaller than those based on CO.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Lower alpha_CO=0.8 or M82 excitation considered to reconcile CO and dust masses but disfavored

evidence.quote: such a high CO excitation scenario is ruled out by our 1mm line observations

limitations_admitted.value: Dust SED poorly sampled; dynamical mass highly model-dependent

evidence.quote: Our dust SED is only poorly sampled.

referee_caveats_inferred: Small sample of 11 galaxies selected by expected CO brightness
Optical positions and fixed line widths for upper limits affect limits
Dust and CO sizes differ, so masses may trace different components
